task: independent-site refit with event-time behavior inputs and retrospective session-energy proxy targets
grid: floor minimum valid connection to ceil maximum valid disconnect, UTC; no outcome-based truncation
split_indices: floor(T*0.70), floor(T*0.775), floor(T*0.85); all input and target bins contained in their segment

node_selection.station_alias_policy: coalesce stationIDs sharing a stable parking space; never count aliases as independent nodes; reject a stationID mapping to multiple spaces
node_selection.rank: descending mature training session count; lexical spaceID tie break
node_selection.failure: stop if fewer than ten eligible spaces; no test-based reselection

availability: events strictly before origin bin end; instantaneous event reporting assumed, not measured; final energy and unfinished departure forbidden in inputs
target: equal-bin session energy in kWh/15min; retrospective proxy, not metered power
label_maturity: proxy final-label time assumed no earlier than max(disconnectTime, nonmissing doneChargingTime); all fitting/evaluation labels mature strictly before segment end; mature contiguous train prefix for scaler and graphs; actual metadata publication delay unmeasured
target_event: access OR departure OR absolute proxy jump above positive training-jump 90th percentile

rule.multi_horizon: origin trigger broadcast to four horizons

graphs.pattern_phase: 96-step UTC phase anchored at first grid timestamp, not civil-day average

missingness: do not infer telemetry uptime from absent sessions; zeros mean no recorded session contribution, not certified actual zero demand; report monthly gaps without outcome-based deletion
scope: another site within ACN, historical overlapping period; no zero-shot transfer, no genuinely later-period or real-power claim
test_status: no model predictions or metrics inspected; only schema/identity/coverage QC permitted before lock
